title: Hex dependency declared from a local path
description: mix.exs declares a dependency resolved from a directory on the build machine. A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a dependency resolved from a directory on the build machine.
remediation: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a dependency resolved from a directory on the build machine.
limitation: It matches a dependency resolved from a directory on the build machine in the parsed mix.exs; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
